notes.title: DDT - Update 1.09
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Here is a new update:
 
- Multiplayer library updated
- Game over fixed
- Fix crash when changing resolution in multiplayer sessions

Thank you all for your feedbacks and for playing the game!

The DotEmu Team

notes.title: DDT - Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Thanks for your feedbacks, we have just uploaded a new version of the game:

- enhancement of multiple resolution stability
- protection for cheated scores

Be sure to close and restart Steam to get the new version.
By the way, we are still working on the others issues, thanks for your patience.

The DotEmu Team

notes.title: Double Dragon Trilogy update
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Thanks to your feedbacks and bug reports, the dev team has just uploaded a new version of the game. 

- Game endings fixed
- Fix issue with Hurricane Kick achievement detection
- Enhance support of resolution changes

Be sure to close and restart Steam to get the new version.

By the way, we are still working on the others issues, thanks for your patience and we are really sorry for the unconvenience.

The DotEmu Team
